notes: Village, modified cash basis. Governmental figures from Total Governmental Funds column (p5, p7). Beginning cash = fund balance as originally reported 1,579,712 with restatement -616,732 as an adjustment (restated 962,980). LB 840 loan proceeds 61,372 are printed inside Total revenues, so moved to debt_proceeds and reported_totals.receipts includes debt_proceeds. Business-type from Proprietary Funds statements (p8-10): measure net position (no liabilities; net position 591,912 = cash 589,420 + restricted cash 2,492); beginning 1,587,368; transfers to other funds -1,000,000; receipts = sales 1,092,214 + other revenue 5,039 (operating total 1,097,253) + interest 1,439. Business-type disbursements are the operating expense lines (total 1,094,148), all classed utilities. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position (modified cash basis), Total column; no liabilities printed. Detail: recorded the General Fund departments combining schedule (p12-13, 6 departments) as the more detailed one; the all-funds budgetary comparison (p11) was not recorded to avoid double counting (final budget amounts only appear there; e.g. total resources budget 1,964,202). Pages with Library column printed on p13 continuation. Added the business-type charges to appropriations (Electric, Water, Sewer, Trash; actual and budget) from the all-funds budgetary comparison (p11) to detail, tied to its printed Total business-type 1,094,148; the governmental part of that schedule is still not recorded (departments schedule is more detailed), and its resources are not split by fund. Read pages 1-13 of 13. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p6-7, p9) added for the funds that had no schedule. The General Fund departments lines (p12-13) are kept (they tie to the General Fund column). LB 840 loan proceeds 61,372 are printed inside the LB 840 Fund's Total revenues but are debt proceeds at top level, so the detail line is in section other financing with printed_in revenue. The business-type budget-schedule lines (p11) are replaced by the proprietary statement lines.
